title.zh: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
title.en: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act

current_state.zh: 美联储理事会已提出两项规则以实施其在《GENIUS法案》下的职责，目前开放60天公众评论，内容涵盖稳定币收益/奖励、资本与储备要求，以及受监管银行发行稳定币的程序。
current_state.en: The Federal Reserve Board has proposed two rules to implement its portion of the GENIUS Act, now open for 60-day public comment, covering stablecoin yield/rewards, capital and reserve requirements, and procedures for supervised banks to issue stablecoins.

updates.title_zh: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
updates.title_en: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
updates.what_changed_zh: 美联储的两项提案进入60天公众评论期，并新增披露内容包括稳定币收益/奖励计划治理、资本与储备要求，以及受美联储监管银行发行稳定币的程序。
updates.what_changed_en: The Fed's two proposals were opened for 60-day public comment periods and newly detailed coverage includes governance of stablecoin yield/rewards programs, capital and reserve requirements, and procedures for Fed-supervised banks to issue stablecoins.
updates.current_state_zh: 美联储理事会已提出两项规则以实施其在《GENIUS法案》下的职责，目前开放60天公众评论，内容涵盖稳定币收益/奖励、资本与储备要求，以及受监管银行发行稳定币的程序。
updates.current_state_en: The Federal Reserve Board has proposed two rules to implement its portion of the GENIUS Act, now open for 60-day public comment, covering stablecoin yield/rewards, capital and reserve requirements, and procedures for supervised banks to issue stablecoins.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. Federal Reserve proposed two rules to implement its portion of the GENIUS Act, including governance of stablecoin yield and rewards programs, opening both to a 60-day public comment period.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve proposed two rules to implement its portion of the GENIUS Act, including governance of stablecoin yield and rewards programs, opening both to a 60-day public comment period.
